# RES observability for Corporate Mobility

> Markdown (GEO/AEO) version of <https://mauricio.issei.com.br/en/proposta-observabilidade-mobile>. Author: **Maurício Yokoyama Issei** · en-BR · Published: 2026-03-10 · Updated: 2026-06-21.

## In short

An architecture of **end-to-end observability** for fleets of corporate devices, uniting **Datadog, Azure and Android Enterprise** to transform an opaque fleet into actionable telemetry — and reduce time for detection and problem solving in the field.

- **End-to-end visibility** — from device to cloud, in one vision.
- **Datadog** — correlated metrics, logs and strokes.
- **Azure + Android Enterprise** — identity, management (MDM) and fleet telemetry.
- **Lower MTTR** — detect and resolve before the impact on the user.

## Frequently Asked Questions

**What is RES observability for corporate mobility?**

It is the ability to see, from end to end, the health of a fleet of corporate devices — from device to cloud — with correlated metrics, logs and dashes. The goal is to detect and solve problems in the field before they affect the user.

**Why Datadog, Azure and Android Enterprise together?**

Datadog correlates metrics, logs and strokes; Azure provides identity and backend; Android Enterprise manages the fleet (MDM) and exposes device telemetry. Integrated, give a unique and actionable view of the fleet.

**What result does architecture deliver?**

Reduction of detection time and resolution (MTTR) of incidents in the field, fewer blind spots in the fleet and operational decisions based on real telemetry rather than assumption.
